publicLimitation: 官网与出版物可确认高迪故居的建筑身份、屋顶外廓和花园环境，但已检查的图册、论文附图及博物馆资料均未提供室内正投影平面；本场馆不进入室内模型加载器。

sources.finding: The official Park Guell page identifies the model house, its authorship by Francesc Berenguer i Mestres and Gaudi's residence there from 1906 to 1925, but publishes no indoor plan.
The official maps and services page confirms visitor access and park-level context; its downloadable map is an illustrated site map, not an indoor orthographic plan of the Gaudi House Museum.
Official ICGC north-up orthophoto verifies the roof footprint and garden context only.
The inspected MUHBA publication provides facade and elevation evidence but no usable indoor floor plan.
Pages 8, 11 and 12 were visually inspected. The book shows a Gaudi House Museum photograph and Park Guell/other Gaudi-building drawings, but no interior floor plan for the museum house.

Pages 27-35 were visually inspected. Page 34 contains Park Guell planning, Casa Trias plans, entrance-pavilion plans and a photograph/description of the sample house; it does not contain the Gaudi House Museum interior plan.
